carousel.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addresses the Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. He said farm growth had averaged over 4 percent over the past decade and that 50 crore people had defeated poverty.
carousel.nri_angle: Modi's claims frame the farm economy many diaspora families still draw income and land from; the figures are the Prime Minister's, citing a World Bank study, and are reported here as his address stated them.

carousel.title: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi Comedy Vibe Arrives on Prime Video November 13
carousel.excerpt: Kunal Kemmu's Hindi action-comedy Vibe, co-starring Preity G Zinta and Sparsh Shrivastava, premieres on Prime Video on November 13, 2026 after a September theatrical run. It is Kemmu's second film as director, after Madgaon Express.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora viewers can stream this new Hindi film on Prime Video from November 13, 2026, with a subscription, as reported by the sources read.

carousel.title: New Zealand Thrash India 5-0 in Auckland in First Friendly
carousel.excerpt: An early Bijoy Varghese own goal, a Jesse Randall brace, and second-half goals from Chris Wood and Lachlan Bayliss gave New Zealand a 5-0 win in the opening match of India's New Zealand tour; the sides meet again in Christchurch on Sunday.
carousel.image_caption: India's starting eleven pose for a team photograph before the friendly at Go Media Stadium in Auckland. New Zealand won the match 5-0, with Jesse Randall scoring twice.
carousel.nri_angle: India's first match in New Zealand drew the diaspora's football fans in Auckland; the second friendly in Christchurch on Sunday, November 15 is the next chance to watch the Blue Tigers in person or on the morning IST broadcast.

carousel.title: ISRO Test-Fires Revised PSLV Third Stage After Two Flight Anomalies
carousel.excerpt: The strengthened PS3 solid motor was successfully ground-tested at Sriharikota on November 12 after anomalies on PSLV-C61 and PSLV-C62; ISRO says further tests will follow a detailed review of the data, and has not declared the vehicle ready to fly.
carousel.image_caption: A solid motor fires during a ground static test at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. ISRO tested the revised PSLV third stage on November 12 after anomalies on two earlier missions.
carousel.nri_angle: The PSLV is the vehicle that has carried many of the Indian and commercial satellites diaspora-linked startups and universities fly; its return to flight depends on this qualification sequence.

carousel.title: Vodafone Idea Q2 Loss Widens After One-Off Charge, ARPU Rises
carousel.excerpt: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Vodafone Idea's reported net loss widened to Rs 5,975 crore after a Rs 462 crore exceptional charge, even as its pre-exceptional loss narrowed and ARPU rose to Rs 198.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora investors tracking Indian telecom holdings get the reported-versus-expected distinction and the one-off charge behind the wider headline loss.
